redCandidate.publicEntry: BattleSimulation.TryFire, EndActiveTurn and Tick through the Unity EditMode battle harness
redCandidate.setup: Two real laser-fence deployment shots land. The opponent is placed at their midpoint, its motor is synchronized, then its turn begins.
redCandidate.expected: The opponent loses the configured 42 base damage once and its active turn ends.
redCandidate.observed: The opponent remains at 100 HP after two simulation ticks.
redCandidate.failureReason: Grounded laser nodes are registered, but Tick has no beam-link contact and damage resolution.
